title: KickAss 12V Jaffle Maker $19.95 (RRP $49.95) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ KickAss Products
body:
Deal: KickAss 12V Jaffle Maker $19.95 (RRP $49.95) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ KickAss Products

[Clear] Oh you know I need this. Now get me a deal on red ripperz
[jv] a deal on red ripperz
These are way better…
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] I thought it's elgato stream deck (cheaper version). 😅
[bargaino] Camping? $20 will buy a real jaffle iron that your grandchildren will inherit.
[jv] your grandchildren will inherit.
They'll put "Grandpa was cheap… " on your tombstone.
[Franc-T] Real ones make absolutely brilliant sandwitches
[UncleRico] Oh, you’re one of those hot jaffle snobs…
[jv] 340W seems rather underpowered
Get two and you'll have stereo…
[Kikkoman56] I'm sure it'll work fine enough, I have a Hardkorr 12v anderson plug kettle that pulls the same power and it gets enough water boiling for 1 cup of coffee in ~4 minutes. I'd imagine this would do the job in a similar amount of time?
I'm tempted to buy one even though I already have one meant to be used over a stove or campfire but I don't really need it…
[shoppe] Requires 50A fuse. Really should be included.
[OZKap] just rawdog it straight from the battery, what's the worst that could happen?
[corbz] If you're running unfused anderson plugs you deserve the consequences
[Buyingcrap] Also requires a battery, why don't they include that? Or at least a small lithium mine.
[hgaoxhgaox] sandwich maker is an alternative, 10 bucks in kmart
[Mortin] This one you can plug straight to a battery box
[Gunnar] 340 watts? The only thing that has more power than it is the v8 79 series which it will be driven around in
[toasty] check all the one star reviews before purchase
[miguelala] I have one and do not recommend.
These jaffle makers are very shallow.
Putting 2 x slices of cheese and some ham, will cause the cheese too ooze out everywhere.
Don’t even think about bake beans or tin spaghetti.
[JarrodRebecchie] Hot damn now I want a Tip Top cheese and spaghetti jaffle.
[mfazackerley] Yeh these definitely work but I agree it was a shock how thin it is
